# Equipment

`world-system`

Equipment categories and traits (Phase 295): every held item is equipment of a category, and what it can do in the world (fell, mine, dig, build, pick a lock, dissect, cut bone) follows from its traits by the work table. There are no tools that cannot be used in combat; picks are the weakest weapons.

> One rule for what a held item can do, in work and in combat, instead of a tool type per item

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| damageTypes | json | The combat damage types a trait deals |
| traits | json | { <Trait>: { damageType, damage } \| { damageType, grades: { <grade>: { damage } } } }, grades weakest first |
| categories | json | { <category>: { hands, clipFamily, combatMultiplier, defaultTraits } } |
| materialTraits | json | { <material>: { raise: { <Trait>: +strength }, add: { <Trait>: { strength, grade? } } } } for the working part |
| workTraits | json | { <work>: { bareHands, ways: [{ category?, traits: { <Trait>: { grade? } }, speed }] } } |
| categorySummary | json | Derived: per category its hands, traits, what it can do and its combat multiplier |
